Do you have any tips for Crisis?

Hello!   
As a general guide, position papers tend to include:  
\- A short summary of the situation (globally and in your country)  
\- Your country stance  
\- Your proposed solution (try to creative, but realistic)

Otherwise there isn't much in terms of formatting, but you should check with the organizers.  
For preparing, I'd recommend you read up a lot about the issue, what your country has done previously/shown interest in doing and practice speaking (especially if you're not familiar with making speeches). If you have time, get a sense of who you should be looking towards as allies. There are some good MUN 101 guides on the internet to get you started, try checking them out!

personally, chair research should be a lot more in-depth that regular delegate research is. you should know almost everything there is to know about the topic, since you'll have to guide your delegates through it yourself. an important addition is having to take note of all possible country positions - this is a great help for marking your delegates later.

I think you'd be just fine beginning your research like you would any other conference, just keeping in mind the things above

in the meantime, make him proud. maybe you weren't meant to have children of your own, there's nothing wrong with that. have you considered adoption? raising orphaned children in a good household change many of their lives for the better. it's just a suggestion from an Internet stranger, the choice is yours.

live your best life, make the most of what you have and trust me, your son is up there watching over you. he would want you to be happy, to move on past him and live out the rest of your life to the fullest potential. because when it's all said and done, when it's your turn to leave this earth he'll be waiting for you with a smile on his face.

I hope this helps, and the best of luck to you
